info.title: Clinozy Backend API
info.description:
Backend API. Includes authentication, multi-tenant organization management, billing, notifications, webhooks, and admin operations.

All authenticated endpoints require a Bearer JWT token in the Authorization header. Organization-scoped endpoints also require the appropriate permission.

tags.MCP: Model Context Protocol — tools and resources for agents (requires admin JWT when ENABLE_MCP_SERVER=true)
tags.Email Login: Passwordless sign-in with an emailed verification code
tags.Session: Session management — list and revoke active sessions
tags.Auth Method: Manage linked authentication methods (password, OAuth, etc.)
tags.User Settings: User personal settings (dark mode, language, etc.)
tags.Notification Preferences: Per-user notification type and channel preferences
tags.User Management: Admin user management — list, update, suspend, delete users
tags.Audit Log: Audit trail of actions performed in the organization
tags.Invitation: Membership invitations — create, accept, decline, resend
tags.Permission: Available permissions that can be assigned to roles
tags.Subscription: Subscription lifecycle — create, upgrade, cancel, resume
tags.Stripe Webhook: Stripe billing webhook receiver (raw body, signature verified)
tags.Webhook: Webhook endpoint management and delivery history
tags.Upload: Pre-signed URL generation for file uploads
tags.Branch: Branches — locations, hours and who works where
tags.Saved view: Saved list views — each person's named filters and hidden columns
tags.Offering: Offerings, offering groups and offers — what the organization sells and at what price
tags.Contact: Contacts — one record per person, shared by their lead, patient file, appointments and activity
tags.Contact activity: A contact's stream — WhatsApp and Instagram messages, call logs, notes and server events
tags.Contact message template: Reusable texts for outgoing WhatsApp and Instagram messages
tags.Branch resource: Rooms, machines and holidays of a branch
tags.Preference: Each person's own settings — pinned sections, branch filter, theme
tags.Lead: Leads — enquiries until the person becomes a patient
tags.Appointment: Appointments — booking, confirming, check-in, cancel and the slots
tags.Patient file: A patient's file — clinical notes, prescriptions, images, reports and notes
tags.Invoice: Invoices, packages and offering suggestions — numbered per branch GSTIN and financial year (D23)
tags.Payment: Payments, pending credits, credit notes and the day close
tags.Treatment: Treatment sessions — reversed with a reason, never deleted (P89)
tags.Feedback: Check-ins, reviews and the actions taken on them
tags.Medical store: The medical store — medicines, suppliers, manufacturers, reps, purchase orders and sales
tags.Stock: Consumable stock — items, vendors, purchases, movements and counts
tags.Task: Tasks — the work queue, its rules and their automatic handling

components.bearerAuthDescription: JWT access token obtained from the login or token refresh endpoint.

responses.notAcceptable: Not acceptable — required Accept header missing or unsupported
responses.payloadTooLarge: Request body exceeds the size limit
responses.tooManyRequests: Too many requests — rate limit exceeded
responses.unauthorized: Unauthorized — the Authorization header is missing, malformed, or carries an expired/revoked access token. Obtain a token via POST /api/v1/auth/login (or /auth/refresh) and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>`.
responses.unprocessableEntity: Unprocessable entity — business rule violation or idempotency key reused with a different payload
